description: Defines the TextFrame class in the MigraDoc library, representing a customizable text container with margins, orientation, and content elements such as paragraphs, charts, tables, and images.

classes.name: TextFrame
classes.description: Represents a flexible text container with margins, orientation, and content elements, supporting deep copy and visitor pattern.

classes.name: TextFrame.TextFrameValues
classes.description: Internal nullable properties for TextFrame, including margins, orientation, and content elements.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the TextFrame instance.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copy operation, including cloning of child elements.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph to the text frame.

methods.name: AddChart
methods.description: Adds a new chart with specified type.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds a new image by filename.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an existing paragraph, chart, table, or image to the content elements.
